verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed developer.playcanvas.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200, and a runtime probe found a 2 MB llms-full.txt with the complete docs. There are also per-product llms.txt files (React, Web Components, SuperSplat, SplatTransform, PCUI, Editor), and new projects ship with PlayCanvas Skills that give AI coding agents engine-specific workflows. The documentation claims and the independent probes agree, so every element of the story is covered with hands-on confirmation.
